e.title: insurance-distill
e.summary: GBM→GLM 蒸馏（burning-cost，MIT）：黑箱模型蒸馏为可解释费率表
e.body: insurance-distill（burning-cost，PyPI，MIT）做 GBM→GLM 蒸馏：把黑箱 GBM 模型蒸馏为可解释的 GLM 费率表（surrogate factor tables）——精度与可解释性的平衡。对 RIAA：精算可解释性的现代方法——「ML 精度 + 传统费率表形式」的蒸馏（同 [[credibility-gated-xai]] 的可解释谱系）；与 [[machine-learning-pricing]]（ML 定价）配套：先 ML 后蒸馏的可解释管线；监管友好的费率呈现（PRA/监管期望可解释）；「解释性 × 精算」的课程/论文方向。
e.verified_note: 源码核实：burning-cost 仓库 + PyPI 确认（GBM→GLM 蒸馏，MIT，Colab 教程），未实测
e.summary_en: GBM-to-GLM distillation (burning-cost, MIT): distil black-box models into interpretable rate tables
e.summary_hk: GBM→GLM 蒸餾（burning-cost，MIT）：黑箱模型蒸餾為可解釋費率表
e.body_en: insurance-distill (burning-cost, PyPI, MIT) performs GBM→GLM distillation: distilling black-box GBM models into interpretable GLM rate tables (surrogate factor tables) — balancing accuracy and interpretability. For RIAA: a modern method of actuarial interpretability — 'ML accuracy + traditional rate-table form' via distillation (sharing the explainability lineage of [[credibility-gated-xai]]); with [[machine-learning-pricing]] (ML pricing) it builds an ML-then-distill explainable pipeline; regulator-friendly rate presentation (PRA/regulatory expectations of explainability); a course/thesis direction of explainability × actuarial.
e.body_hk: insurance-distill（burning-cost，PyPI，MIT）做 GBM→GLM 蒸餾：把黑箱 GBM 模型蒸餾為可解釋的 GLM 費率表（surrogate factor tables）——精度與可解釋性的平衡。對 RIAA：精算可解釋性的現代方法——「ML 精度 + 傳統費率表形式」的蒸餾（同 [[credibility-gated-xai]] 的可解釋譜系）；與 [[machine-learning-pricing]]（ML 定價）配套：先 ML 後蒸餾的可解釋管線；監管友好的費率呈現（PRA/監管期望可解釋）；「解釋性 × 精算」的課程/論文方向。
